ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level dominance of low-intensity dark pixels across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity white pixels concentrated solely at the distal tips and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottled clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; the central ventral surface is a uniform low-intensity grey with no significant internal mapping.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Clear acute V-shaped central notch dividing the fluke into two distinct lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with variable pixel amplitudes; serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the right lobe relative to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch transitioning to tapered, upwardly-curved lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Circular high-contrast white pixel clusters present at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable depigmentation or scarring at both fluke tips; irregular trailing edge profile suggests physical wear or minor tissue loss.
